_text: [building excitement] Then you look in your cereal box, and the sun has a *bite* missing. [dramatic] You see, the sun stopped. But the Moon DIDN'T. [quick, excited] Those dots on your window? That was the Moon, sneaking closer every *day*. [playful] Every twenty-nine days, it walks in front of the sun, like your little brother in front of the TV. [building excitement] The street goes *dim*. The air drops ten degrees. The streetlights flick *on*. [dramatic] Then the last sliver of sun *vanishes*. [amazed] And for the first time in twenty-nine days... the stars come out. [excited] Kyle's whole basement empties into the street, to look *up*.
